title: Alternative Dance
style: Dark Synthpop / 1980s New Wave / Darkwave Mid-tempo, hypnotic groove Driving rhythmic analog synth bass sequence Classic 80s drum machine with steady pulse Minimalist verses, emotional chorus lift Atmospheric pads, subtle arpeggiators Short repeating melodic synth hook Moody, obsessive, intimate tone Male baritone vocals, calm and emotional British accent Catchy, repetitive chorus that feels compulsive Depeche Mode–inspired but original
lyrics:
[Intro]
(instrumental pulse, bass sequence begins alone)
Closer... closer...

[Verse 1]
I count your breath in the dark of the room
Every silence pulls me deeper into you
I trace your name in my head like a sign
Every thought repeats, every thought aligns

I don’t pray, I don’t kneel
But I wait for the way that you make me feel

[Pre-Chorus]
There’s a hunger I can’t confess
A need I don’t resist
I don’t want release
I want this

[Chorus]
Love as obsession
Skin on my mind
Over and over
You take your time

Love as obsession
Truth in disguise
I don’t need freedom
I need your eyes

(hook repeats, mantra-like)

[Verse 2]
Every word that you never say
Still controls me in a quiet way
I give myself without a sound
I don’t fall — I spiral down

I don’t ask to be saved
I choose every chain that I crave

[Pre-Chorus]
There’s a fire I won’t suppress
A mark beneath the skin
I don’t want innocence
I want in

[Chorus]
Love as obsession
Ritual touch
Slow and deliberate
Never too much

Love as obsession
Faith without proof
I don’t need heaven
I need you

[Bridge] (drop drums briefly, bass filters down)
Say my name like a warning sign
Say it once and it’s never mine
If this is wrong, don’t make it stop
I don’t want clarity
I want the thought

(bass sequence returns, stronger)

[Final Chorus]
Love as obsession
Written in me
I don’t want distance
I want belief

Love as obsession
Don’t let me go
I don’t need answers
I need to know

[Outro]
(instruments strip back)
Closer...
Over and over...
